description: Na₂SnSe₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted pentagonal planar geometry to five Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.90-3.31 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.86-3.27 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.86-3.51 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to five Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with six SnSe₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with two NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 59°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.97-3.04 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with five SnSe₄ tetrahedra, corners with two NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one SnSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  a faceface with one NaSe₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.93-3.41 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to five Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with six SnSe₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with two NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 48°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.11 Å. There are four inequivalent Sn sites. In the first Sn site, Sn is bonded to four Se atoms to form SnSe₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two SnSe₄ tetrahedra, and corners with five NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 46°. There are a spread of Sn-Se bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.66 Å. In the second Sn site, Sn is bonded to four Se atoms to form SnSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two SnSe₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 74-78°. There are a spread of Sn-Se bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.64 Å. In the third Sn site, Sn is bonded to four Se atoms to form SnSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SnSe₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four equivalent NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 62°. There are a spread of Sn-Se bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.64 Å. In the fourth Sn site, Sn is bonded to four Se atoms to form SnSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SnSe₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 61°. There are a spread of Sn-Se bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.65 Å. There are eleven inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to three Na and two Sn atoms to form distorted SeNa₃Sn₂ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SeNa₄Sn square pyramid, corners with three SeNa₃Sn₂ trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one SeNa₂Sn₂ trigonal pyramid, and edges with three SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Sn atom. In the third Se site, Se is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Sn atom. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded to four Na and one Sn atom to form distorted SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SeNa₄Sn square pyramid, corners with two SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one SeNa₂Sn₂ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one SeNa₃Sn₂ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one SeNa₂Sn₂ trigonal pyramid. In the fifth Se site, Se is bonded to four Na and one Sn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth Se site, Se is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Sn atom. In the seventh Se site, Se is bonded to two Na and two Sn atoms to form distorted SeNa₂Sn₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two SeNa₃Sn₂ trigonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramid. In the eighth Se site, Se is bonded to four Na and one Sn atom to form SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one SeNa₄Sn square pyramid, and edges with four SeNa₃Sn₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the ninth Se site, Se is bonded to four Na and one Sn atom to form distorted SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SeNa₄Sn square pyramid, corners with four SeNa₃Sn₂ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one SeNa₄Sn square pyramid, and edges with two SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids. In the tenth Se site, Se is bonded to four Na and one Sn atom to form distorted SeNa₄Sn square pyramids that share corners with five SeNa₃Sn₂ trigonal bipyramids and edges with two SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids. In the eleventh Se site, Se is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Sn atoms.
